evidence: Touches src/dbwrapper.cpp, src/validation.cpp, and src/txdb.cpp under the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label.
rationale: Prevents crashes and shutdown hangs caused by background chainstate compaction exhausting available disk space. Issue #36585 reported that background compaction introduced in v32.0rc filled the disk and caused node hangs on shutdown, making this an important regression fix directly impacting node reliability and crash safety.
